name: Library Board of Trustees Regular Meeting Agenda Packet (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE

  ALHAMBRA PUBLIC LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES

  TUESDAY, December 14, 2021, 6:00 p.m.

  (NOTICE NO. N2M21-150)

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE

Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-08-21 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the State of
California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order, the Alhambra
Public Library Board of Trustees will not be physically open to the public and will take place via video
conference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency and public
access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:

Zoom Meeting direct link: https://zoom.us/j/92285934397?pwd=Y0srK0NEa3JOc0w3L2Zlc3ZqdGNqQT09
Meeting ID: 922 8593 4397 and Password: 91801

Or by telephone by dialing 1 669 900 6833, 1 408 638 0968, 1 346 248 7799, 1 253 215 8782, 1 646 876 9923,
1 301 715 8592, or 1 312 626 6799 and entering Meeting ID: 922 8593 4397 and Password: 91801. Please
Note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can
proceed.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Maribel Kong at maribel@alhambralibrary.org
by 4:30 pm on the day of the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your name. You should
then call or log into the meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Hilda LohGuan will announce to you
when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.

As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to Maribel Kong at
maribel@alhambralibrary.org no later than 4:30 pm the day prior to the meeting to ensure that it will be printed
prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance
of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after
4:30 pm the day prior to the meeting, but before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the
comment will still be included as part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.

Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should e-mail
or call Maribel Kong at maribel@alhambralibrary.org or (626) 570-5079 by 4:00 pm on the Thursday prior to
the meeting who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much
accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference
meetings, all participants are encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.

  Hilda LohGuan
  Library Director

Dated: December 8, 2021
Notice No. N2M21-150
